achievements.reason: No Steam achievement list: RAWG lists Gears of War 3 only on Xbox 360 and Xbox One, with no PC store, and no Steam app of this name is in the store list. RAWG has 82 achievements with its own percentages; the 40 shown on its first page include campaign Acts on Insane, 4-player co-op Acts, 15 COG Tags, all 42 Collectibles, Horde and Beast waves, Versus matches, the Arcade campaign and the "RAAM's Shadow" campaign, which could seed an original checklist and mode chapters later.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 28632). Console only (Xbox), so steam=None. StrategyWiki has "Gears of War 3" at completion stage 0: only Achievements (about 12,700 characters), Gameplay (about 1,700) and Table of Contents (about 400) are written, and the contents page lists only Gameplay, Controls, Characters, Enemies, Weapons, Walkthrough and Achievements, with no act or chapter pages, so there were no page names to build chapters from. The four chapters are therefore a broad outline from RAWG's description only; the titles and summaries are our own short words. RAWG keeps one DLC entry, "Gears of War 3: RAAM's Shadow" (2011-12-13). gearsofwar.fandom.com answers the API under "Gears of War 3" with about 346 linked articles (characters, weapons, places, battles and series titles, plus a "Gears of War 3 walkthrough" page); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
